name: David Shandalov
biography: David Shandalov works as a security researcher at Deep Instinct. His role involves researching and identifying new cyber threats and vulnerabilities, and developing tools for threat detection and analysis. David began his journey in cybersecurity as a Malware Researcher at Checkpoint and, prior to that, served in the IDF's intelligence corps. Outside of research, David enjoys flying and is currently working on obtaining his Private Pilot License.
